suggestion: Make the official game book the availability system of record
proposal: Every completed game already publishes a PDF with starting lineups on both sides and an explicit Not Active list. Fetch, hash and parse all 136 of them; store starter and inactive per player per game
risk: Low: the file is the league's own
evidence: Two books opened and read: NE@SEA wk1 and NYG@WAS wk5 both carry Offense, Defense, Substitutions, Did Not Play and Not Active
recommended_path: Adopt first. It answers "who replaced whom" with a league document instead of an inference

suggestion: Replace depth rank with measured participation
solves: XQ-03, and the whole backup-replacement requirement
proposal: Stop trying to source a 1st-to-4th string chart the league does not publish. Define replacement as: the player who started, against the player who started the previous week at that slot
evidence: The league's depth-chart path returns its 404 page; club sites cover 12 to 13 of 32 clubs at best
recommended_path: Adopt. It converts an unanswerable question into a measurable one

suggestion: Publish a fetch timestamp on every count, and fail the build without one
proposal: The repository already does this well on the root tree; extend the rule so no measured number can render without the instant it was measured
evidence: 254 rows at 04:45Z became 279 rows by 22:35Z, four hours later
recommended_path: Adopt as a build rule, not a convention

suggestion: Make the staleness diff a first-class output, not an error to hide
proposal: Ship a "what changed since the last snapshot" table on every data page: rows added, rows removed, cells that moved, with the club and player named
evidence: The diff here is precise: 25 added rows, 4 changed practice cells, 0 removed
recommended_path: Adopt. It is the most useful page in this build

suggestion: Freeze the luck filters into a single pass rule before more data arrives
proposal: Write one sentence per filter and one combined rule, sign it off, and refuse to promote any strategy that fails a single filter
risk: Medium: freezing it early will reject strategies people like
evidence: A 95% band on ROI is about 8.9 points at n=100 and still 2.8 points at n=1,000
recommended_path: Adopt. A gate written after the results is not a gate

suggestion: Publish the sample-size band next to every performance number
proposal: Wherever a hit rate or ROI appears, show the interval implied by its sample, or show nothing
evidence: n=136 games gives a +-1.6 to +-8.9 point band depending on bet count, which is wider than any edge claimed so far

suggestion: Declare one tree the system of record and label the others as evidence
proposal: The root register is writable; the seven sibling trees are read-only evidence with their own generators and their own claims
risk: Medium: it demotes work other sessions published
evidence: Four trees publish different counts of the same n=32 correlation family
recommended_path: Adopt, with a visible banner rather than deletion

suggestion: Grade props and parlays only after the price feed exists
proposal: Keep the prop and parlay sections blank with a stated reason until a licensed price exists. Publish the correlation you can measure on outcomes, and say that a correlation is not a price
risk: Low: it means shipping fewer pages
evidence: Measured: home vs away points r = +0.076 on 136 games. No price exists to convert it

suggestion: Add a negative-control strategy to the leaderboard permanently
proposal: One strategy that is guaranteed to lose by construction (bet the home team every week). If it ever ranks near the top, the gate is broken
evidence: Home teams went 67-68-1 in the verified log, so the control is close to a coin flip by construction

suggestion: Commit the abbreviation crosswalk as data
proposal: One file mapping LA to LAR, and every other variant, checked by the build
evidence: The league's own pages disagree between LA and LAR for the same club

suggestion: Give every question a named decision and a deadline
proposal: Each open question gets an owner, a decision date and a visible consequence of doing nothing
evidence: Questions in this repository have been open across at least nine sessions without changing status

suggestion: Separate "the snapshots disagree" from "one of them is wrong"
proposal: Two fetches four hours apart are not a contradiction; they are two times. The bug is presenting either as timeless
evidence: Six clubs' blocks changed between the two fetches today
